content.short: Algorithmically generated art using artificial inteligence.
content.description:
Entheos was the first AI based algorithmically generated art project on Cardano. The goal behind the project was to give users a creative and interactive experience in generating Entheos artwork NFTs using artificial intelligence.

The project is educationally based as we strive to teach and inspire other AI artists in the space, and help show how theses AI algorithms work by revealing what goes on behind the scenes.

The project was started in late April and and has gown to be one of the top selling projects on Cardano.
